verdict.rationale: A built-in AI agent is a fair question for a terminal emulator, since some terminals ship one, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows WezTerm ships an agent that plans and runs commands with user approval. The `wezterm cli` spawn, send-text and get-text loop is only a building block an external agent could drive, not a built-in agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate terminal tasks to a built-in AI agent that plans and executes commands with my approval
